races.verdict: A match on paper between GINOLO and Mysterland , with marginal preference for the former who pulled clear with a promising sort on debut at Worcester last month. GINOLO (IRE) MYSTERLAND (FR) AR AGHAIDH LEAT (IRE)

races.verdict: CADILLAC RANCH is relatively unexposed for one at this level and has built up a good rapport with his amateur rider. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE) MARKET HOUSE (IRE) PRAIRIE DIAMOND (IRE)
